proof_body:
by
  intro f hf
  by_cases hd : Dense (Set.range f)
  · exact Or.inr hd
  left
  rw [dense_iff_closure_eq] at hd
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, a ∉ closure (Set.range f) := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    exact hd (Set.eq_univ_of_forall h)
  rw [Metric.mem_closure_iff] at ha
  push_neg at ha
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hfar⟩ := ha
  have hfar' : ∀ z, ε ≤ ‖f z - a‖ := fun z => by
    have := hfar (f z) ⟨z, rfl⟩
    rwa [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm] at this
  have hne : ∀ z, f z - a ≠ 0 := fun z h => by
    have := hfar' z
    rw [h, norm_zero] at this
    linarith
  have hg : Differentiable ℂ (fun z => (f z - a)⁻¹) := (hf.sub_const a).inv hne
  have hb : Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range fun z => (f z - a)⁻¹) := by
    refine (Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_closedBall 0).mpr ⟨ε⁻¹, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
    simp only [mem_closedBall_zero_iff, norm_inv]
    exact inv_anti₀ hε (hfar' z)
  intro z w
  have := hg.apply_eq_apply_of_bounded hb z w
  have h2 := inv_injective this
  exact sub_left_injective h2
target_source: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ), Differentiable ℂ f → (∀ z w, f z = f w) ∨ Dense (Set.range f)
